display_long_description:
Travel around the town on your skateboard, **Rob people for money**, offer them **Free drugs**, hustle around the city, **Fight or escape cops**, **Grow weed/coca plants**, **Cook meth and Cocaine**, do chemical **Mixing**, **Invest** in properties, play in **Casino** or just do **Trash picking jobs**. The world is limitless🌿
[media]
# Ride around on your skateboard and organize your house and warehouse 🏭
[media]
# Plant seeds and water and harvest cannabis and coca trees. Run the lab to cook meth and process cocaine. Also, upgrade the lab to a warehouse with superior seeds and mixing for higher profits 🧑‍🔬
[media]
# Increase your profit margins by extending your product with a variety of chemical additives and watch your customers react to your custom batches🧪
[media]


[media]


- Find your Customers by **offering Free Drugs**

- Grab your board and skate seamlessly through the city to meet clients, escape trouble and you can **ride the skateboard in third person view as well as in regular view**

- Dodge cops, Take care of the cartel and protect your stash.

- Manage your finances, upgrade your equipment and scale your underground business into a massive operation and make **One Million Dollars** 😁


To learn more about the game's manual and mixing and to join Discord: https://www.raxsam.info/wiki/ddsvr
